IMPRS-QST Doctoral Fellowships
The IMPRS-QST Doctoral Fellowships are no longer offered as a separate program. Doctoral fellowship applications are now handled through the Munich Center for Quantum Science and Technology (MCQST).
If you are interested in pursuing a PhD in quantum science and technology in Munich, please visit the MCQST website for information about the MCQST Doctoral Program, MCQST Doctoral Fellowships, eligibility requirements, application procedure, and research opportunities.
MCQST Doctoral Fellowships
Learn more about the MCQST Doctoral Fellowships
The MCQST Doctoral Fellowship application is conducted through a shared application platform. Applicants can apply for the MCQST Doctoral Fellowship, the Munich Quantum Valley (MQV) Doctoral Fellowship, or both.
Learn more about the application process
Apply through the online application platform
Please note that the eligibility requirements for the MCQST Doctoral Fellowships differ from the former IMPRS-QST program. In particular, the fellowships are open only to external applicants who did not complete their Master’s studies or Master’s thesis in Munich.
Application 2027
Online Application
The next call for applications for the MCQST Doctoral Fellowships will open in October 2026 for admission in Fall 2027. Stay tuned for updates!
